# Welcome to the Laqta Community! 🎬✨

Welcome to the official discussions forum for **Laqta (لقطّة)** — the open-source, local-first long-video-to-Shorts studio!

Whether you are a podcast creator, YouTuber, AI researcher, or open-source contributor, we are thrilled to have you here.

---

## 🌟 What is Laqta?
Laqta helps you turn long-form videos into ranked, ready-to-publish vertical 9:16 Shorts directly on your machine.
- **100% Local-First:** Your media never leaves your PC. Zero mandatory cloud accounts, zero telemetry.
- **Arabic-First UX:** Native RTL layout, BiDi isolate markers, and Arablish Whisper prompts.
- **Explainable Clip Potential Score (CPS 0–100):** You can see the exact signals that justified each cut.
- **Tuned for modest hardware:** Runs smoothly on an 8 GB CPU laptop.

---

## 💬 How to use this forum

- 💡 **[Ideas & Feature Requests](https://github.com/thewizard2030/laqta/discussions/categories/ideas):** Have an idea for subtitle animations, layout templates, or export formats? Let's discuss it!
- 🤝 **[Show and Tell](https://github.com/thewizard2030/laqta/discussions/categories/show-and-tell):** Made a great Short with Laqta? Share it with the community!
- ❓ **[Q&A / Help](https://github.com/thewizard2030/laqta/discussions/categories/q-a):** Troubleshooting local FFmpeg, Faster-Whisper, or Node setup.
- 🛠️ **[Contributing](https://github.com/thewizard2030/laqta/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md):** Look out for issues labelled `good first issue`.
